changes: Date: chronogram resolved as abhra (0) – abdhi (4) – śikharin (7) – indu (1), read right to left, giving Śaka 1740. 'vara' is taken as a corrupt or filler element, not a digit. ce_approx set to 1818 (ŚS+78); year field changed to 1740.
Scribe p2: removed residence 'Vārāṇasī'. The colophon gives Vārāṇasī only as the place of copying ('vārāṇasyām iti śeṣaḥ'), not as where the scribe lived.
Scribe p2: confidence lowered to medium. The name division (Lālaratna + dharaṇītridaśa = bhūdeva, i.e. brāhmaṇa) is a reading, not explicit.
Author p1: titles normalized; 'tarkālaṃkāra' kept as a title. 'mahāmopādhyāya' is the colophon's form of mahāmahopādhyāya.
Notes rewritten: the chronogram is not unreadable, and the metre is irregular.

date.as_written: abhrevarāvdhi śikharīndumite śake vyorjja śaubhra pakṣa guruvārayutā jajāhe

notes: Chronogram: 'abhrevarāvdhi śikharīndu-' is read as abhra (0) – abdhi (4) – śikharin (7) – indu (1). Read right to left this gives Śaka 1740 (about 1818 CE), which fits a copy of a work by Jagadīśa (about 1600). 'vara' (or 'abhre') is corrupt and does not give a clean digit. It could be emended (e.g. svara = 7), but that would give one digit too many, so the reading is uncertain. The first pāda of the Vasantatilakā verse seems to be a syllable short, which supports corruption here. 'vyorjja' = vā ūrja (Kārttika). 'śaubhra' = śubhra/śukla. 'jajāhe' is probably for jagāhe/jajñe. The catalogue gives the scribe as 'Śrīlālaratnadharaṇī'. The better reading is śrī-Lālaratna, a dharaṇītridaśa ('god on earth', i.e. a brāhmaṇa). The work is Jagadīśa's ṭippaṇī on the Dīdhiti on the Siddhāntalakṣaṇa portion of the Tattvacintāmaṇi ('siddhāntalakṣaṇakadīdhiti ṭippaṇīṃ'). Raghunātha and Gaṅgeśa are not named, so they are not listed.
